notes.title: Tropical jungle scene unblocked
notes.content:
The most dangerous scene is opened for every one when you start to play.
In this scene is more difficult to see the dinosaurs, however they can find you easily.
Primates are more difficult to follow and you have to use minimap and light in some parts of the scenar.
Play with your friends in this scene unblocked and try to pass all the missions.
Good luck!
